title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE First Language English Paper 1 (Reading)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE First Language English 0500 Paper 1 (Reading): comprehension of Text A (20 marks), a summary of Text B (20 marks), and short answers, a language task and an extended response on Text C (40 marks), 2 hours, 80 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its texts and questions are not past-paper material.
instructions:
Answer **all** the questions. You have 2 hours; spend about 15 minutes reading the texts.

- Question 1 (20 marks): Text A. Question 2 (20 marks): Text B, a summary of no more than 120 words in your own words. Questions 3 and 4 (40 marks): Text C.
- Dictionaries may not be used.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, matching and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 1 of the 2027-2029 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE First Language English Paper 2 (Directed Writing and Composition)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE First Language English 0500 Paper 2: directed writing based on one or two texts (Section A, 40 marks) and one composition from a choice of four titles, two descriptive and two narrative (Section B, 40 marks), 2 hours, 80 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its texts and questions are not past-paper material.
instructions:
Answer the question in Section A and **one** question from Section B. You have 2 hours.

- Section A (40 marks): read the text(s) and answer both parts; part (b) asks for 250-350 words.
- Section B (40 marks): write 350-450 words on one title.
- Dictionaries may not be used.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, matching and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 2 of the 2027-2029 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

sections.title: Section A: Directed writing (40 marks)
sections.instructions: Answer both parts of the question.

sections.title: Section B: Composition (40 marks)
sections.instructions: Answer one question: two descriptive and two narrative titles.
